invented_facts: The Aurora 14 can reduce cloud workstation costs; no cost comparison or savings evidence is provided.
Engineers can access client files offline and process drawings and project files locally; the attachments do not establish those specific workflows.
Client drawings and project files never leave the device unless authorized; the spec sheet does not support this absolute security claim.
Storage is user-upgradeable; the spec sheet confirms two M.2 slots but explicitly calls only memory user-upgradeable.
Ordering now would position the buyer for deployment when a new budget cycle opens; ordering and deployment timing are not specified.
notes: All three emails have subjects and one explicit CTA, but emails 1 and 2 exceed 120 words when the CTA is included. The sequence addresses the persona’s concerns, yet unsupported cost and security claims make it unsuitable to send without substantive edits.
